caption: The drawing features a centrally placed ornamental object resembling a brooch or pendant on a plain, light beige background. The object consists of two main circular elements vertically aligned, connected by gold lines. The upper, larger circle has a gold border with an outer ring embellished with small gold spheres and decorative scrollwork extensions. Inside the gold border is a ring of red gemstones encircling a central image with a golden hand-like shape and purple background. The lower, smaller circle also contains a red gemstone in the center with a thin gold border and similar though smaller decorative gold work. Three gold drops with pointed ends hang from the lower circle, attached via small gold rings, and two shorter pointed drops hang symmetrically from either side of the lower circle. The drawing is executed with clear, precise lines and the main colors used are gold, red, and purple. The composition is vertical and symmetrical. At the bottom right corner, there is a signature in cursive that reads "White."
title: Brooch
